Daegu (Daegu) — Guida di Viaggio Corea del Sud: Cosa Vedere, Trasporti e Cucina

Historic cultural district, Traditional market (Sijang), Mountain & river parks, Local museum & heritage trail. Connected via KORAIL KTX / SRT high-speed rail, Express Bus terminals, and T-money nationwide transit card.

RegioneDaegu (Daegu)
Hub PrincipaleDaegu Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)
Tutte le Città147

Come Arrivare e Muoversi

Connected via KORAIL KTX / SRT high-speed rail, Express Bus terminals, and T-money nationwide transit card.

Cucina Locale e Specialità

  • Korean BBQ (Samgyeopsal & Hanwoo)
  • Bibimbap
  • Kimchi jjigae
  • Tteokbokki & street food
  • Local makgeolli
